an4.122:1.4: imāni kho bhikkhave cattāri bhayāni udakorohantassa pāṭikaṅkhitabbāni.
an4.122:1.5: evameva kho bhikkhave idhekaccassa kulaputtassa imasmiṃ dhammavinaye saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito cattārimāni bhayāni pāṭikaṅkhitabbāni.
an4.122:2.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco kulaputto saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti
an4.122:2.3: “otiṇṇomhi jātiyā jarā, maraṇena, sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi, dukkhotiṇṇo dukkhapareto,
an4.122:2.4: appevanāma imassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa antakiriyā paññāyethā”ti.
an4.122:2.5: tamenaṃ tathā pabbajitaṃ samānaṃ sabrahmacārī ovadanti anusāsanti :
an4.122:2.6: “evaṃ te abhikkamitabbaṃ. evaṃ te paṭikkamitabbaṃ. evaṃ te āloketabbaṃ. evaṃ te viloketabbaṃ. evaṃ te samiñjitabbaṃ. evaṃ te pasāritabbaṃ. evaṃ te saṅghāṭipattacīvaraṃ dhāretabbanti.”
an4.122:2.8: “mayaṃ kho pubbe agāriyabhūtā samānā aññe ovadāmapi anusāsāmapi.
an4.122:2.9: ime panamhākaṃ puttamattā maññe, nattamattā maññe, ovaditabbaṃ anusāsitabbaṃ maññantī”ti.
an4.122:2.10: so kupito anattamano sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattati.
an4.122:2.11: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu ūmibhayassa bhīto sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvatto.
an4.122:3.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco kulaputto saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti
an4.122:3.3: “otiṇṇomhi jātiyā jarāmaraṇena, sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi, dukkhotiṇṇo dukkhapareto,
an4.122:3.4: appevanāma imassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa antakiriyā paññāyethā”ti.
an4.122:3.5: tamenaṃ tathā pabbajitaṃ samānaṃ sabrahmacārī ovadanti anusāsanti :
an4.122:3.6: “idaṃ te khāditabbaṃ, idaṃ te na khāditabbaṃ, idaṃ te bhuñjitabbaṃ, idaṃ te na bhuñjitabbaṃ, idaṃ te sāyitabbaṃ, idaṃ te na sāyitabbaṃ, idaṃ te pātabbaṃ, idaṃ te na pātabbaṃ. kappiyaṃ te khāditabbaṃ, akappiyaṃ te na khāditabbaṃ, kappiyaṃ te bhuñjitabbaṃ, akappiyaṃ te na bhuñjitabbaṃ, kappiyaṃ te sāyitabbaṃ, akappiyaṃ te na sāyitabbaṃ, kappiyaṃ te pātabbaṃ, akappiyaṃ te na pātabbaṃ, kāle te pātabbaṃ, vikāle te pātabbaṃ, kāle te khāditabbaṃ, vikāle te na khāditabbaṃ, kāle te bhuñjitabbaṃ, vikāle te na bhuñjitabbaṃ, kāle te sāyitabbaṃ, vikāle te na sāyitabbanti.”
an4.122:3.8: “mayaṃ kho pubbe agāriyabhūtā samānā yaṃ icchāma taṃ khādāma, yaṃ na icchāma taṃ na khādāma,
an4.122:3.9: yaṃ icchāma taṃ bhuñjāma, yaṃ na icchāma taṃ na bhuñjāma,
an4.122:3.10: yaṃ icchāma taṃ sāyāma. yaṃ na icchāma na taṃ sāyāma,
an4.122:3.11: yaṃ icchāma taṃ pibāma, yaṃ na icchāma taṃ na pibāma,
an4.122:3.12: kappiyampi khādāma, akappiyampi khādāma, kappiyampi bhuñjāma, akappiyampi bhuñjāma, kappiyampi sāyāma, akappiyampi sāyāma, kappiyampi pibāma, akappiyampi pibāma, kālepi khādāma, vikālepi khādāma, kālepi bhuñjāma, vikālepi bhuñjāma, kālepi sāyāma, vikālepi sāyāma, kālepi pibāma, vikālepi pibāma.
an4.122:3.13: yampi no saddhā gahapatikā divā vikāle paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā denti, tatrāpime mukhāvaraṇaṃ maññe karontī”ti.
an4.122:3.14: so kupito anattamano sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattati.
an4.122:3.15: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu kumbhīlabhayassa bhīto sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvatto.
an4.122:4.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco kulaputto saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti
an4.122:4.3: “otiṇṇomhi jātiyā jarāmaraṇena, sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi, dukkhotiṇṇo dukkhapareto.
an4.122:4.4: appevanāma imassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa antakiriyā paññāyethā”ti.
an4.122:4.5: so evaṃ pabbajito samāno pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisati arakkhiteneva kāyena arakkhitāya vācāya arakkhitena cittena anupaṭṭhitāya satiyā asaṃvutehi indriyehi.
an4.122:4.6: so tattha passati gahapatiṃ vā gahapatiputtaṃ vā pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitaṃ samaṅgībhūtaṃ paricārayamānaṃ.
an4.122:4.8: “mayaṃ kho pubbe agāriyabhūtā samānā pañcahi kāma guṇehi samappitā samaṅgībhūtā paricārimha.
an4.122:4.9: saṃvijjante kho pana me kule bhogā.
an4.122:4.10: sakkā bhoge ca bhuñjituṃ puññāni ca kātuṃ.
an4.122:4.11: yannūnāhaṃ sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattitvā bhoge ca bhuñjeyyaṃ puññāni ca kareyyanti.”
an4.122:4.13: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu āvaṭṭabhayassa bhīto sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvatto.
an4.122:4.14: āvaṭṭabhayanti kho bhikkhave pañcannetaṃ kāmaguṇānaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
an4.122:5.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco kulaputto saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti
an4.122:5.3: “otiṇṇomhi jātiyā jarāmaraṇena, sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi, dukkhotiṇṇodukkhapareto.
an4.122:5.4: appevanāma imassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa antakiriyā paññāyethā”ti.
an4.122:5.5: so evaṃ pabbajito samāno pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisati arakkhiteneva kāyena arakkhitāya vācāya arakkhitena cittena anupaṭṭhitāya satiyā asaṃvutehi indriyehi.
an4.122:5.6: so tattha passati mātugāmaṃ dunnivatthaṃ vā duppārutaṃ vā.
an4.122:5.7: tassa mātugāmaṃ disvā dunnivatthaṃ vā duppārutaṃ vā rāgocittaṃ anuddhaṃseti.
an4.122:5.8: so rāgānuddhaṃsitena cittena sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattati.
an4.122:5.9: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu susukābhayassa bhīto sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvatto.
an4.122:5.12: imāni kho bhikkhave cattāri bhayāni idhekaccassa kulaputtassa imasmiṃ dhammavinaye saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitassa pāṭikaṅkhitabbānīti.
